title: Check status of a specific background job
summary: Check the status of a single background job by its job number. Use this when you want to verify if a specific task is still running, stopped, or finished.

steps.explain: Use the jobs command followed by the job number (prefixed with %) to see its status.

placeholders.name: JOB_ID
placeholders.description: The number of the job (e.g., 1, 2) as shown in the jobs list.
